title: Orchestration Landscape Scan
summary: Milestone 1b evidence-tagged scan of agent-orchestration frameworks against nine program constraints, recommending an amendment to ADR-012's candidate set.
scope: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore in AWS GovCloud
notes: Type taken from MANIFEST_TYPE (DOC); heuristic and content signals would otherwise have contended between DOC and ADR-adjacent, since the document ends in a recommended amendment to ADR-012 (section 8) and raises Q-14. It is a research scan feeding a decision, not the decision record itself, so DOC is correct and precedence 5 is honored. Downstream extraction must preserve two things. (1) Every claim carries an evidence tag -- [measured], [first-party], [secondary], or [unverified] -- and the tag must travel with any quoted claim; the Diagrid claim about Strands resume behaviour is explicitly [unverified] from an interested vendor and must never be extracted as fact. (2) This document supersedes blueprint.md section 9's framework comparison, which evaluates AutoGen and Semantic Kernel as live options when both moved to maintenance mode in April 2026; blueprint section 9 content should be treated as stale where the two conflict. Net effect on the candidate set: LangGraph, Strands, and hand-rolled Python confirmed; PydanticAI / Pydantic Graph dropped as an orchestrator candidate (retained for contracts); nothing added.
